title: OpenAPI contract should use OpenAPI 3.x
source: Project-authored rule informed by OpenAPI Specification
recommendation_template: Use an OpenAPI 3.x contract for the generated API.

title: API operation identifiers should be unique
recommendation_template: Assign a unique operationId to every API operation.

title: Database foreign-key targets should exist
recommendation_template: Correct foreign-key references so that they point to existing database entities.

title: API operation identifiers should use a consistent readable format
Security-sensitive API operations should have explicit security requirements
source: Project-authored rule informed by OWASP API security guidance
applicability: API operations and their source functional requirements exist.
semantic_instruction: Determine whether any supplied API operation appears security-sensitive based only on the supplied requirements and artifacts. If a sensitive operation exists but no explicit authentication or authorization requirement or security declaration is present, return FAIL. Do not invent JWT, OAuth, API keys, roles, or any other mechanism. If no sensitive operation exists, return PASS.
recommendation_template: Define explicit authentication and authorization requirements for the identified security-sensitive operation.

title: Availability requirements should have supporting design evidence
source: Project-authored rule informed by software quality guidance
applicability: At least one Availability NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Assess whether the supplied architecture and design artifacts contain evidence supporting the Availability NFR. Use only supplied evidence. If the artifacts do not contain enough information to judge the requirement, return SKIPPED rather than inventing architecture features.
recommendation_template: Add explicit architecture or operational design evidence showing how the Availability requirement will be supported.

title: State-changing API operations should define failure responses
applicability: A Fault Tolerance NFR exists and state-changing API operations are present.
recommendation_template: Define appropriate 4xx or 5xx failure responses for state-changing operations.

title: Legal requirements should have traceable design evidence
applicability: At least one Legal NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Check only whether the supplied Legal NFR is reflected by explicit design evidence. Do not give legal advice and do not determine legal compliance. If the available design artifacts are insufficient to evaluate the NFR, return SKIPPED.
recommendation_template: Add explicit traceable design evidence for the Legal requirement and obtain appropriate human or domain review where needed.

title: Look and Feel requirements should have relevant design evidence
applicability: At least one Look and Feel NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Determine whether the supplied artifacts contain evidence relevant to the Look and Feel NFR. If no UI, interaction, or presentation artifact is supplied, return SKIPPED because the requirement cannot be evaluated from architecture, database and API artifacts alone.
recommendation_template: Provide an appropriate UI or interaction design artifact before evaluating the Look and Feel requirement.

title: Component responsibilities should remain cohesive
source: Project-authored maintainability rule informed by software design principles
applicability: A Maintainability NFR and component responsibilities exist.
semantic_instruction: Assess whether detailed responsibilities remain reasonably aligned with their architecture-defined component responsibilities. Identify clear evidence of mixed or unrelated responsibilities only. Do not invent new architecture boundaries.
recommendation_template: Refine component responsibilities so that each component remains focused on its architecture-defined purpose.

title: Operational requirements should have design support
applicability: At least one Operational NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Evaluate whether the supplied design artifacts contain evidence supporting the Operational NFR. Do not invent deployment, monitoring, logging, recovery, or infrastructure mechanisms that are not present.
recommendation_template: Document the operational design mechanisms needed to satisfy the Operational requirement.

title: Collection retrieval endpoints should expose bounded retrieval controls
applicability: A Performance NFR exists and collection GET operations are present.
recommendation_template: Add a bounded retrieval mechanism such as page, limit, offset or cursor parameters to collection retrieval operations.

title: Portability requirements should be supported by architecture evidence
source: Project-authored portability rule informed by software quality guidance
applicability: At least one Portability NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Assess whether the architecture contains evidence supporting the supplied Portability NFR. Do not assume portability merely because a technology is common. Return SKIPPED when the supplied artifacts are insufficient.
recommendation_template: Document architecture decisions and abstractions that support the Portability requirement.

title: Collection retrieval should avoid unbounded result sets
applicability: A Scalability NFR exists and collection GET operations are present.
recommendation_template: Add pagination or another bounded retrieval mechanism to collection endpoints that may grow significantly.

title: Explicit Security NFRs should be represented by API security declarations
source: Project-authored rule informed by OWASP API security guidance and OpenAPI
applicability: At least one Security NFR exists.
recommendation_template: Define and apply an explicit API security scheme that is consistent with the approved Security requirement.

title: Usability requirements should be reflected in consumer-facing API design
applicability: At least one Usability NFR exists.
semantic_instruction: Evaluate only API-design evidence relevant to the supplied Usability NFR, such as clarity and consistency of operations. If the NFR concerns a user interface rather than an API, return SKIPPED.
recommendation_template: Improve the relevant consumer-facing design evidence or provide the UI artifact needed to evaluate the Usability requirement.
